Definition: Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah
BiblicalUsage: Jehovah-jireh = "Jehovah sees"; 1) symbolic name given by Abraham to Mount Moriah in commemoration of the interposition of the angel of Jehovah who prevented the sacrifice of Isaac and provided a substitute
